_comment: Build-context images for this app. CI (the image-build job in .github/workflows/ci.yml) iterates `images` as a matrix, so it is never hardcoded to backend+frontend: add an entry here to build a new container automatically. `service` is the image name suffix (GHCR publishing is added in TEC-1094); compose.prod.yml uses the same contexts via BACKEND_IMAGE / FRONTEND_IMAGE.
